# Antigravity Agent Guidelines (AGENTS.md)
> Engineering Specification and Multi-Model Subagent Orchestration Standard for Antigravity 2.0 and AI Coding Agents.

## Overview
- Title: Antigravity Agent Guidelines & Best Practices v1.0
- Author: Alphaxiaoteng
- Repository: https://github.com/Alphaxiaoteng/antigravity-agent-guidelines
- Compatibility: Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI (agy), Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini 3.7 Flash

## Key Topics
- First Principles: Product-first thinking, Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD), Evidence over inference, Occam's razor, Ponytail minimal changes.
- Anti-Hallucination: Three-state anchoring, Tool output windowing truncation, No placeholder destruction, Two-strike circuit breaker.
- Model Allocation: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Tiered Thinking: Low, Medium, High), Gemini 3.7 Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-5.x.
- Subagent Architecture: Coordinator thread, Executive Builders, Adversarial Red-Team reviewers.
- Harness Protocol: Prompt caching optimization, Process self-reclamation, 80-line rule guardrail.
